payload.purpose: Check timestamp coverage before freezing annual windows; no price decoding

plan.adaptation: Reuse the frozen daily price-index implementation. No fitting, parameter search, optimizer, volatility overlay, calibration, or selection of a favorable year/scenario.
plan.advance_gate: For BOTH assets: adequate pooled sample; at least five positive years and positive median annual change under both Alpaca-25 base and friction stress; positive multiplicity-adjusted pooled lower bounds against cash and passive. Passing authorizes only an offline risk-constrained follow-up, never paper activation.
plan.fees_are: 25 bps per side is Kairos's Alpaca planning reserve, not a verified historical/account fee. Stress changes spread/slippage without changing that reserve.

inference.family: 2 assets x 2 references x (8 annual windows + 1 pooled series); Alpaca-25 base case only

plan.matched_control_requirement: 2025 gross and fee-40 full index artifacts must equal the previous Kraken pilot artifacts; 25-versus-40 decisions must be identical. Only fee changes in that comparison.
plan.pooling: Concatenate dated annual daily return observations without filling omitted boundaries. Moving blocks cannot cross missing year-boundary intervals. No joined lifetime portfolio return is reported. Historical regime weighting is not a forecast of future regime frequencies.
plan.risk_boundary: Unfunded, unconstrained price indices omit execution minima, liquidity and Kairos risk controls. They neither fix nor pass the prior execution-validity gate. Risk-constrained simulation remains a separate prerequisite to any forward paper consideration.
plan.status: Retrospective exploratory chronological evaluation, not a blind test or fitted walk-forward model. 2025 was already examined; all 2026 data and the consumed final window remain excluded.
plan.windows: Separate flat-start annual windows from January 1 opening through December 31 opening. Preserve prior warm-up; omit the last daily interval of each year consistently. No annual cash reset is represented as an executable portfolio.

note: All annual/scenario summaries and study events are published. Detailed annual decisions, marks, episodes and nonprimary daily series remain in the separate Kraken registry at the referenced hashes. No Alpaca market data or new final holdout.
